newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria natbank allots 6.44 bln ATS in 2-wk repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria natbank allots 6.44 bln ATS in 2-wk repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it had allotted 6.44 billion schillings ($541.4 million) in two-week securities repurchase agreements, or repos, at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent.
The bank said it had filled nine percent of bids.
Last week, the bank allocated 12.83 billion schillings, filling 12 percent of bids, also at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 257 ($ = 11.89 Austrian Schillings)
